create_environment: create a Hanabi game environment with specified game type and number of players
create_agent: create a DQN or Rainbow agent configured for the Hanabi environment with observation stacking
run_experiment: run a full training experiment with iterations, logging, and checkpointing for a Hanabi RL agent
initialize_checkpointing: initialize checkpointing by reloading the latest agent and logger state from a checkpoint directory
run_one_iteration: run one training iteration with optional periodic evaluation on the Hanabi environment
